dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a real-valued function Z on Ω, LocalDef001 μ Z is the totalized Bochner integral ∫ Z dμ, interpreted probabilistically as the totalized expectation Eμ[Z].
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies every integral in the two asserted equalities: the expectation of XY, the expectation of X², and the expectation of |X|².

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: LocalDef002 μ X Y is defined to be LocalDef001 μ applied to the pointwise product ω ↦ X(ω)Y(ω), hence Eμ[XY].
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The first conjunct unfolds this definition and asserts that Eμ[XY] equals the integral of the same pointwise product.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: LocalDef003 μ X is the real square root of LocalDef001 μ applied to the pointwise square ω ↦ X(ω)², hence √(Eμ[X²]).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the left side of the second conjunct, which compares √(Eμ[X²]) with √(Eμ[|X|²]).

dependency_coverage.name: AddCommMonoidWithOne.toAddMonoidWithOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects an additive commutative monoid-with-one structure to the weaker additive monoid-with-one structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It participates only in constructing the natural-number cast used to interpret the ENNReal exponent 2 in MemLp; it adds no mathematical hypothesis or conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: AddMonoidWithOne.toNatCast
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the canonical natural-number casting operation from an additive monoid-with-one structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It helps interpret the numeral 2 as an element of ENNReal for the MemLp exponent.

dependency_coverage.name: And

dependency_coverage.name: ContinuousENorm.toENorm
dependency_coverage.meaning: This extracts the extended norm operation from a continuous extended-norm structure.

dependency_coverage.name: ENNReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: ENNReal is the type of nonnegative extended real numbers, obtained by adjoining a top element +∞ to the nonnegative reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The exponent supplied to MemLp is the ENNReal value 2, and the Lp seminorm is compared with +∞ in the finiteness condition.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Eq a b is equality of two objects of the same type.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: HPow.hPow applies the exponentiation operation supplied by a heterogeneous power instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For a real base and natural exponent 2 it is ordinary squaring, used in X(ω)² and |X(ω)|².

dependency_coverage.name: MeasurableSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: A MeasurableSpace Ω specifies the measurable subsets of Ω.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It equips the arbitrary underlying type Ω with the measurable structure relative to which μ, measurability, MemLp, and the integrals are defined.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure
dependency_coverage.meaning: IsProbabilityMeasure μ asserts that μ is a probability measure, in particular that μ(Ω)=1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It restricts μ to probability measures. No independence, centering, or distributional assumption on X or Y is introduced.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.Measure
dependency_coverage.meaning: MeasureTheory.Measure Ω is the type of countably additive measures on the measurable space Ω.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The quantified μ is the measure used by both MemLp hypotheses and every integral in the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.MemLp
dependency_coverage.meaning: MemLp f p μ means that f is almost-everywhere strongly measurable with respect to μ and that its extended Lp seminorm is strictly below +∞.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The hypotheses say separately that X and Y are L² functions with respect to μ. Mathematically this makes X², |X|², and XY integrable, although those integrability facts are not themselves explicit conclusions.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instNeZeroSucc

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul

dependency_coverage.name: Real.normedCommRing

dependency_coverage.name: Real.sqrt

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is applied to each totalized integral in the second equality. Under the L² hypothesis the integrands are nonnegative and integrable, so these are the ordinary square roots of their nonnegative integrals.

dependency_coverage.name: SeminormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: This forgets commutativity from a seminormed additive commutative-group structure.

binders: A measure μ on that measurable space.
An instance asserting that μ is a probability measure.
Two arbitrary everywhere-defined functions X,Y: Ω → ℝ.
hypotheses: X belongs to L²(μ): it is μ-almost-everywhere strongly measurable and has finite extended L² seminorm.
Y belongs to L²(μ): it is μ-almost-everywhere strongly measurable and has finite extended L² seminorm.
conclusions: The locally defined pairing of X and Y equals the totalized expectation of their pointwise product: LocalDef002 μ X Y = Eμ[X Y].
The locally defined square-root second moment of X equals the square root of the totalized expectation of its pointwise squared absolute value: LocalDef003 μ X = √(Eμ[|X|²]).
mathematical_definitions: For any real-valued Z on Ω, Eμ[Z] denotes the totalized Bochner integral ∫Ω Z(ω) dμ(ω), with value zero under Mathlib's nonintegrable fallback semantics.
LocalDef002 μ X Y := Eμ[ω ↦ X(ω)Y(ω)].
MemLp X 2 μ means that X is μ-almost-everywhere strongly measurable and its extended L² seminorm is finite.
All products, powers, absolute values, and square roots are the ordinary real operations; in particular |x|²=x² for every x∈ℝ.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every measurable space Ω, every probability measure μ on Ω, and every pair of real-valued functions X and Y that belong to L²(μ), both of the following hold: the locally defined pairing of X and Y is exactly the totalized expectation ∫Ω X(ω)Y(ω) dμ(ω), and the locally defined quantity √(∫Ω X(ω)² dμ(ω)) is exactly √(∫Ω |X(ω)|² dμ(ω)). The first equality unfolds the definition of the pairing, while the second uses the pointwise real identity |X(ω)|²=X(ω)².

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The theorem is scoped only to measures carrying an IsProbabilityMeasure instance; it does not state the corresponding result for arbitrary finite or infinite measures, even though the displayed definitional identities may hold more generally.
X and Y are raw functions Ω → ℝ, not elements of an L² quotient space. Their L² hypotheses are almost-everywhere properties, but the quantified objects remain specific representatives.
The conclusions are equalities of real numbers obtained after integration, not pointwise equalities of functions and not almost-everywhere equalities.
No independence, identical distribution, centering, finite mean, or other probabilistic relation between X and Y is assumed.

The Bochner integral is totalized, so every displayed integral has a value even outside its ordinary integrability domain. The L² hypotheses mathematically imply integrability of X², |X|², and XY, but the target does not explicitly assert those integrability facts.
The probability-measure and L² assumptions are antecedents. For a measurable space and measure lacking the required probability instance, this declaration supplies no conclusion about that measure.
The theorem does not assert that LocalDef003 is a norm on functions or on equivalence classes; it only proves the displayed scalar identity for each representative X.

Because μ is a probability measure, the measurable space cannot realize the zero measure as a probability measure in the usual nondegenerate setting; no separate nonemptiness assumption on Ω appears explicitly.
